DE-9 male right-angle D-sub, top view: nine bent leads from the pads to the shallow rear plastic body, metal flange with two mounting holes, D-shell mouth facing +y (off the board edge)

svg.text: Onboard Passive DE9 GPIO breakout / source ESD clamps
Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
NO open at rest → HIGH; pressed closed → LOW. Enable Prime PB1 input pull-up.
J1.3 / PB1 and J2.1 share SIG3 directly, with D2 ESD clamp to ground.
J2.5 and J1.10 share GND. Dry button uses only J2.1 and J2.5.
J2.9 carries HOST5V: leave it disconnected. J2.2–4 and6–8 are unused signals.
J3 Qwiic unused; no external sensor, powered module or DE9 serial device is connected.
This is GPIO wiring, NOT an RS232 interface. No board pull-up: enable the Prime input pull-up.
Other DE9 signals and J3 Qwiic unused. GPIO logic only; do not connect an RS232 port.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.

svg.text: DE9 J2.9 carries HOST5V and is NOT connected to the dry button.
Open / broken signal cable reads HIGH only with the Prime input pull-up enabled.
No external switch power or guessed wire colours.
J2 source: DE9 pins, 2.77 mm row pitch / 2.84 mm row separation. Contacts1/5 depicted160 mm apart.
Fitted cable/orientation, whole-art audit, matching P12 artwork and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN.
